projects.notes.kickoff:
Project "{name}" has been started (preparing): {goal}
{maintainer} will work out the project with you: writing the spec, glossary and decision records into the project records, then submitting a charter. Say something here to wake it up.
projects.notes.firstBuildCreated: First build task {task} has been created (planning).
projects.notes.nextBuildCreated: Next build task {task} has been created (planning); its plan will be drafted from this request.
projects.cards.noSummary: The maintainer didn't write a summary
projects.cards.charterText: Charter: {name} (revision {revision}, {kind}, working folder inside the project records, {bash})
projects.material.workdirInRecords: working folder inside the project records
projects.records.head: Project "{name}" ({id}): {goal}
projects.records.charter.title: Charter
projects.records.charter.intro: What the project kickoff settled: scope, goal, how far the first version goes, project type, working folder. Written here by the runtime once the maintainer submits it and you confirm.
projects.records.spec.title: Spec
projects.records.spec.intro: What this project should become. Written by the maintainer during kickoff.
projects.records.glossary.title: Glossary
projects.records.glossary.intro: Terms used in this project: one paragraph per term, saying what it means and which wording to avoid.
projects.records.progress.title: Progress
projects.records.progress.intro: Where things stand and what's next. Updated at the end of each work session.
projects.records.manifest.title: Project inventory
projects.records.manifest.intro: What the project consists of: code repositories, services, scheduled tasks, public entry points, external tools used.
projects.records.scopeRecords.title: Scope records
projects.records.scopeRecords.intro: Results of scope reviews: scope changes you approved, and out-of-scope records.
projects.records.adrReadme:
# Decision records (ADR)

One file per decision, numbered in sequence: `0001-<short-name>.md`. Describe the context, the decision and its consequences.
projects.records.workdirBound: Bound to an external path: {path} (not included in Ergo's backups; rely on the project's own git remote)
projects.records.operationsNote: (Just a rough idea, not an approval: when the project is done the maintainer submits an operations plan, and only your confirmation of that counts.)
projects.records.changesIntro: Changes the maintainer proposed after the charter was confirmed and you approved on a "Charter change" card.
projects.records.changeNoWords: - Based on your own words: none cited
projects.records.standardOverrides.title: This project's standard changes
projects.records.standardOverrides.intro: Project "{name}" ({id}) uses project standard {version}. Below is where this project differs from the default standard; each item was confirmed by the user on a "Standard change" card. The runtime writes this file from the confirmed records, so editing it by hand changes nothing (the maintainer proposes a change and the user confirms it).
projects.records.standardOverrides.noVer: (created before the project standard; no version recorded)
projects.records.standardOverrides.chang: Each change the maintainer proposed and the user confirmed on a "Standard change" card.
projects.maintainer.label: Maintainer of project "{name}"
projects.maintainer.readOnly: The project is archived, so this is read-only. Unarchive it to edit the prompt, reset or compact.
projects.maintainer.cannotCompact: There's no session in progress (the last one ended; the next conversation starts fresh from the project records), so there's nothing to compact
projects.maintainer.gone: The project's maintainer isn't available (the project was deleted or is being deleted)
projects.maintainer.segmentEnded: This session has ended. You can only roll back within the current session (the next conversation with the maintainer starts fresh from the project records)
projects.maintainer.interrupted: The last message was interrupted and the maintainer didn't continue with it. Send it again if needed.
projects.maintainer.interruptedQuoted: The last message "{quoted}" was interrupted and the maintainer didn't continue with it. Send it again if needed.
projects.charterChange.decided: This charter change card has already been handled
projects.charterChange.stale: The charter has changed since, so this card no longer applies
projects.charterChange.rejectedSummary: You rejected charter change {revision}; the charter stays as it is
projects.charterChange.materialConfirmed: Confirmed the charter change of project "{name}": {what}
projects.charterChange.materialRejected: Rejected the charter change of project "{name}": {what}
projects.standardChange.decided: This standard change card has already been handled
projects.standardChange.stale: The standard has changed since, so this card no longer applies
projects.standardChange.rejectedSummary: You rejected standard change {revision}; the standard stays as it is
projects.standardChange.materialConfirme: Confirmed the standard change of project "{name}": {what}
projects.standardChange.materialRejected: Rejected the standard change of project "{name}": {what}
projects.standardBackfill.cardText: Fill in standard documents: project “{name}” was created before the standard, and under standard {version} ({kind}) it's missing: {docs}
projects.standardBackfill.waiting: Your call: {choices} (fill in switches it to this standard and hands a task to the maintainer; skip leaves it as it is)
projects.standardBackfill.chose.backfill: You chose to fill in: task {taskId} created, the maintainer writes them from the project as it is
You chose to fill in: the project now uses standard {version}; nothing was missing any more, so no task
projects.standardBackfill.chose.skip: You chose to skip; won't ask again (to fill them in later, tell the project's maintainer)
projects.standardBackfill.archived: Project “{name}” is archived: unarchive it first
projects.standardBackfill.hint.spec: scope and acceptance, from the charter and what's been built
projects.standardBackfill.hint.architect: one mermaid diagram with the services, frontends and interfaces it uses (each of the three tables needs a row; write “none” if there isn't one)
projects.standardBackfill.hint.progress: where it stands and what's next
projects.standardBackfill.hint.adr: one record per key decision already made (one file each)
projects.standardBackfill.hint.tickets: the readme is already there (tickets/README.md); future work goes one ticket per file, no need to back-fill old ones
projects.standardBackfill.hint.ops: list the operations that can be run on your behalf under tools, following the notes in the file (voice control of this project relies on it); leave the list empty if there are none yet
projects.standardBackfill.hint.custom: as described in this project's standard changes
projects.standardBackfill.backfillSummar: You chose to fill in the standard documents: task {taskId} handed to the maintainer
projects.standardBackfill.backfillNoTask: You chose to fill in the standard documents: the project now uses standard {version}; nothing was missing, so no task
projects.standardBackfill.skipSummary: You chose not to fill in the standard documents; won't ask again
projects.errors.nameTaken: There's already a project called "{name}". Pick another name.
projects.errors.externalPathMissing: Binding an external working folder needs a path (externalPath, absolute)
projects.errors.externalPathNotAbsolute: The external working folder must be an absolute path (like D:\code\ledger), not "{value}"
projects.errors.externalPathClash: The external working folder can't be inside Ergo's {what} or contain it: {path}
projects.errors.toolkitBeforeCharter: Project "{name}" has no confirmed charter yet. The toolkit is available once the charter is confirmed.
projects.errors.toolkitArchived: Project "{name}" is archived, so its toolkit can't be changed. Unarchive it on the project page first.
projects.errors.emptyRequest: Describe the project you want to start
projects.errors.alreadyMaintainer: The maintainer of task {id} already maintains a project, so it can't be turned into one
projects.errors.resetArchived: Project "{name}" is archived and its maintainer chat is read-only, so it can't be reset. Unarchive it on the project page first.
projects.errors.resetUnsupported: This version can't reset maintainers yet
projects.errors.chatDeleted: Project "{name}" has been deleted, along with its maintainer chat
projects.errors.chatArchived: Project "{name}" is archived and its maintainer chat is read-only. To keep talking with the maintainer, unarchive it on the project page first.
projects.errors.unknownNone: There's no project called "{name}" (there are no projects yet)
projects.errors.taskArchived: Project "{name}" is archived, so you can't start tasks for it. Unarchive it on the project page first.
projects.errors.internalArchived: Project "{name}" is archived, so you can't start tasks in it. Unarchive it on the project page first.
projects.errors.internalPreparing: Project "{name}" is still being set up. Start tasks after its charter is confirmed.
projects.build.summaryFirst: The first build task of project "{name}". See the charter in the project records for how far the first version goes.
projects.build.goalRound: Round {round} of building project "{name}". What the user wants: {request} (the previous build task {previousId} "{previousTitle}" is done; see the progress notes and charter {charter} in the project records for what was built)
projects.build.acceptanceRound: What the user asked for this round is done: {request}
projects.build.goalFirst: Build the first version of project "{name}": see the charter in the project records ({charter}) for how far it goes, its scope and what's out of scope
projects.build.acceptanceFirst: Everything under "First version" in the charter is done
projects.build.cardStale: Project "{name}" is now {state}, so this card no longer applies
projects.build.cardStaleRestarted: Project "{name}" is now {state} and building started again, so this card no longer applies
projects.build.abandonedNote: {chose}: project "{name}" is archived (the maintainer chat is read-only).
projects.build.requestMissing: To keep building, write a sentence about what this round should do. The maintainer drafts the next build task's plan from it.
projects.build.cardExpired: The project was {action}, so this card no longer applies
projects.charter.superseded: This charter revision has been replaced by a newer one. See the latest charter card.
projects.charter.alreadyConfirmed: Project "{name}" is now {state}, and its charter has already been confirmed
projects.charter.confirmedNote: Charter confirmed ({decision}): a {kind} project, working folder is {where}, {bash}.
projects.delete.title: Delete project "{name}"?
projects.delete.body: The project records, maintainer chat, charter and the project's internal tasks (along with the memory records created from them) will be deleted, and what {name} and cross-project tasks read from this project will be erased too. This can't be undone. What you yourself said in the maintainer chat is kept as material (original copies aren't affected).
projects.delete.externalKept: The external working folder {path} is left untouched.
projects.standard.check.architectureMiss: architecture.md is missing (projects with services need it, like development projects)
projects.standard.check.servicesEmpty: The “Services” table is empty (write a row “none” if there are none)
projects.standard.check.interfacesEmpty: The “Interfaces” table is empty (write a row “none” if there are none)
projects.standard.check.planServiceUnlis: Services {names} in the operations plan aren't in the architecture
projects.standard.check.opsUnnamed: Tool {n} in ops.json has no name
projects.standard.check.noPlan: No operations plan yet: services {names} from the architecture have to go into it (means: service)
projects.standard.check.serviceNotInPlan: Services {names} from the architecture aren't in the operations plan (means: service)
projects.standard.check.outsideWithoutWe: Interfaces {names} need /apps/ or public access, but the operations plan has no matching service with a web page (web)
projects.standard.check.progressStale: Progress hasn't been written back since entering this state
projects.goLive.notBuilding: Project “{name}” is {state} now; only projects being built can be put in use
projects.goLive.cardStale: Project “{name}” is {state} now; this card no longer applies
projects.goLive.otherConfirmed: Putting it in use was already confirmed on another card; this card no longer applies
projects.goLive.supersededByBuildDone: Replaced by the “first version is done” card: choose Put in use there
projects.goLive.requestedNote: {by}: put project “{name}” in use. The confirmation card is in your to-dos; it only happens once you confirm.
projects.cards.choseMissing: You chose {choice} (confirmed anyway, {count} checklist items missing)
